frame: rest nacelle material frame, transported by source nacelle rotation and translation
angle_basis: User explicitly authorized common inclination adjustment while retaining approximately 2 degree adjacent spacing; +8 degrees from nominal 2/4/6. Angles are to rest downward vertical toward rotor.
range_basis: inherited ideal-simulation range, not a hardware certification
threshold_basis: fixed before source evaluation; conditioning guard, tested with independent analytic perturbations
length_basis: norm([-1, 0, 63]) from independent unloaded prebend structural tip; hub centre includes HubRad=1.5 m, no per-frame fit
hub_source: source nacelle pose and fixed turbine scalars
tower_input: known same-time simulated deformed tower surface
expected_window_basis: fixed before evaluation: each blade azimuth within 15 degrees of downward (180 degrees); full 60 s scanned regardless
alarm_reset: simulation-time hold expires after last hit; unknown channel remains unknown and does not erase history; seeking recomputes prefix state

installation.note: Direct underside mount between rotor and tower, at nacelle centerline. Optical triad common inclination adjusted; displayed housing is illustrative rather than vendor CAD.

selection.criterion: Inner nacelle only; full complete-passage same-blade coverage and at least3 consecutive saved samples, no truth-error fit
selection.sample_scope: 117-177s,40Hz source saves; no continuous or out-of-segment guarantee
selection.choice_note: centerline direct underside attachment preferred over y=+0.5 despite slightly fewer optical samples
